title: EvaluationCsvSpecification
description: Evaluation CSV output schema defining the official jury evaluation format for vehicle sightings and trajectory verification

columns.description: Ordered array of columns defining the evaluation CSV structure

name.description: Column header name in CSV output

format.description: Standard data format (e.g. date-time for timestamps)

description.description: Functional description of the column data

required.description: Whether column value is mandatory for valid records

default.name: department
default.description: Camera owning department (e.g. Police, GSRTC, RTO)

default.name: license_plate
default.description: Detected and normalized vehicle license plate (e.g. GJ01AB1234)

default.name: pts_timestamp_ms
default.description: Hardware presentation timestamp in milliseconds from video container: cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC)

default.name: watchlist_match_flag
default.description: Boolean flag indicating whether plate matched active criminal or stolen vehicle watchlist

default.name: associated_fir
default.description: Linked police First Information Report (FIR) number if watchlisted, or empty if clean

row.description: Schema validating an individual row record in the evaluation CSV dataset

license_plate.description: Detected and normalized license plate number

watchlist_match_flag.description: Whether plate matched any watchlist entry
